data.title: Strive acquires 469 Bitcoin worth $36.6M through preferred stock trades, pushing holdings to 25,000 BTC
data.description: Strive, Inc. has added 469 Bitcoin to its treasury over a four-day stretch, spending approximately $36.6 million at an average price of $77,954 per coin. The purchase, executed between September 8 and 11, pushes the Nasdaq-listed asset management firm's total Bitcoin stash to a clean 25,000 BTC, wo…
